summary: Split out of MPI-579 as MPI-553 phase 1, on Fabio's prompt and over the objection that a mechanism must not ride on a product card - MPI-506 proved the failure by taking the unbuilt mechanism down with SeedVR2. Three extensions to a plugin entity currently shaped for one right-click text action: (1) contribute an ENTRY to the EXISTING MpiToolOptionsUpscale dropdown, both image and video kinds, not a new dropdown; (2) a selected entry contributes its own CONTROLS with a hidden 0-1 mapping, generic because PiD needs it too; (3) a Flow can REQUIRE a plugin (MPI-557 adopts the LTX upscaler) and a plugin can SHARE deps with a ModelDef. On (3b): ltx23-spatial-upscaler is ALREADY an assetDep, already on R2 and already in both LTX tiers' dependencies, so an LTX user needs zero extra download and the plugin derives to installed for free - but a non-LTX user faces a plugin whose install is the whole LTX stack, which needs a product answer. GC is the sharp edge: a dep owned by both a plugin and a model must survive either owner, and both twins get fixed in one pass.

todo -> doing. plan.md written and corrected before any code: the GC fork it opened (a dep owned by both a plugin and a ModelDef) was WITHDRAWN on Fabio's correction that plugins must not differ case by case. Verified in code - qwen3vl-abliterated-clip is already shared between the image-describer plugin and both Krea2 tiers (models.js:686, :802), so the case ships today and the existing rules cover both uninstall directions. No GC code, no product question, downloadManager.js and MpiModelManager.js off the file list. Also recorded: the same capability will ALSO become a Flow, because Flows are the beginner surface and duplication is deliberate - History video first, per Fabio.
Checklist derived from the plan's four phases; files.json written with the 8 paths the plan names (source: plan Files section).

All four phases written and verified. npm test 630/630 (two files carry the new contract: plugin-dep-gc gains the plugin:<id> round trip and proves protection UNCHANGED; declared-fields is new and pins mapTo - UI 0.5 -> sigma 0.675 - plus the Input_ routing law). Driven in a real app:isolated instance against a temporary stub plugin: the entry lands INSIDE the existing dropdown between None and the model files, shows for kind video and not image, reveals its declared controls, and Run emitted values that split into positive + Input_Denoise 0.675. Flow regression clean - ltx-extend fields and head-swap radio still render with byte-identical mpi-base-flow BEM. One real bug caught by the SCREENSHOT and not by the DOM assertions: [hidden] loses to the section class display:flex, so Upscale Factor stayed visible under a plugin entry (and the plugin controls would have leaked under None); fixed with an explicit rule and re-verified through computed style.
Four phases checked off. The open item is Fabio's own look, which needs MPI-579 - no plugin declares `upscale` yet, so the mechanism has no user-visible surface of its own.

Card description healed. Its GC paragraph and its "needs a product answer" line were both written on a premise Fabio corrected: a plugin does not behave differently because its deps are big or belong to a model. Verified in code - the shared-dep case already ships via qwen3vl-abliterated-clip (image-describer + both Krea2 tiers), the existing rules cover both uninstall directions, and the existing test already exercises it. No GC code, no open product question, downloadManager.js and MpiModelManager.js off the file list.
